method.family_test: circular-shift max-|z|, 499 shifts of at least 52 weeks

limitations: Weekly data: a pattern inside a week, or only in some regimes, is invisible in a weekly split.
Prices start 2012-12; positions from 2006 are used only as percentile history.
Labels were fixed before running; 252 correlated tests, protected by an out-of-sample half and a circular-shift family test rather than by a correction that assumes independence.
No result changes strategy logic, risk or the analysis workflow without a separate decision.
